Its closest reviewed Swiss-Prot homologs are annotated as IspD/IspF proteins and match across nearly the full sequence (about 33–35% identity; 97.6–99.0% query coverage).

- **IspD** (EC 2.7.7.60): converts MEP and CTP to CDP-ME.
- **IspF** (EC 4.6.1.12): converts CDP-ME2P to ME-cPP, releasing CMP.

**Likely biological process:** biosynthesis of isopentenyl diphosphate (IPP) through the MEP pathway, contributing to isoprenoid/terpenoid biosynthesis.
